integrity: New spectral arguments are shown in full, cited source results are separated from new steps, computations are illustrative, independent priority and independent mathematical validation are not claimed.
scientific_limitations: Spectral Morse indices concern a selfadjoint transmission linearization for a scalar periodic medium, or the paired-edge-symmetric necklace subspace, not nonlinear Lyapunov stability or asymmetric graph perturbations. The required gap is not optimized; the existence of fronts is taken from Mori, Ogawa and Sintavanuruk.
title: Exact Morse-index classification of separated McKean fronts in periodic necklace media
